* [[Domino Harvey]] dies of an [[Drug overdose|OD]], Harvey was a legendary bounty hunter and her biography was made a movie with Keira Knightley as Domino.
* The [[Supreme Court of the United States]] releases a unanimous decision in ''[[MGM Studios, Inc. v. Grokster, Ltd.]]'', finding that [[Peer-to-peer|P2P]] [[file sharing]] companies can be held liable for the [[copyright infringement]] of their users. [https://www.wired.com/news/digiwood/0,1412,68018,00.html?tw=wn_1culthead (Wired)], [https://web.archive.org/web/20051204144404/http://news.ft.com/cms/s/2672d3cc-e772-11d9-a721-00000e2511c8.html (Financial Times)]
* [[Walmart]] heir [[John T. Walton]] dies when his ultra-light plane crashes right after taking off in Jackson, Wyoming. [http://www.cnn.com/2005/US/06/27/obit.walton/index.html (CNN)]
* [[Kenya]] releases three men suspected of conspiracy to a [[suicide bombing]] in 2002 and links to [[al Qaeda]]. [http://news.bbc.co.uk/2/hi/africa/4625675.stm (BBC)] [https://www.reuters.com/newsArticle.jhtml?type=topNews&storyID=8898799&section=news (Reuters)]{{Dead link|date=August 2021 |bot=InternetArchiveBot |fix-attempted=yes }}
* [[South Africa]]'s [[Congress of South African Trade Unions]] (Cosatu) has organized a nationwide [[Strike action|strike]] to protest job losses and [[unemployment]]. [https://web.archive.org/web/20050912204856/http://www.iol.co.za/index.php?set_id=1 (IOL)] [http://www.reuters.co.za/locales/c_newsArticle.jsp?type=businessNews&localeKey=en_ZA&storyID=8897504 (Reuters SA)]{{Dead link|date=August 2019 |bot=InternetArchiveBot |fix-attempted=yes }} [http://news.bbc.co.uk/2/hi/africa/4625135.stm (BBC)] [https://www.bloomberg.com/apps/news?pid=10000087&sid=aYSwevowRthQ&refer=top_world_news (Bloomberg)]
* In the [[Philippines]], president [[Gloria Arroyo]] apologizes and admits that she took a phonecall to an election official during the presidential elections last. She denies any vote fixing and refuses to resign. [http://www.mb.com.ph/MAIN2005062838072.html (Manila Bulletin)] [http://www.mb.com.ph/MAIN2005062838072.html (Sun Star)] [https://www.reuters.com/newsArticle.jhtml?type=worldNews&storyID=8909718 (Reuters)]{{Dead link|date=August 2021 |bot=InternetArchiveBot |fix-attempted=yes }}
* In [[Mexico]], [[Subcomandante Marcos]] of the [[Zapatista Army of National Liberation|Zapatistas]] announces a "new political initiative" after a week-long meeting in the jungle. [https://web.archive.org/web/20050602075039/http://chiapas.indymedia.org/ (Indymedia Chiapas - Spanish and English)] [http://www.alertnet.org/thenews/newsdesk/N27328575.htm (Reuters AlertNet)]
* [[Greece|Greek]] prosecutor launches a preliminary investigation to determine if Greeks fighting for [[Bosnian Serbs]] were involved with the [[Srebrenica massacre]]. [http://www.alertnet.org/thenews/newsdesk/L27144632.htm (Reuters AlertNet)]
* In [[Bosnia and Herzegovina|Bosnia]], Bosnian Serb police arrests 11 for connection with [[war crime]]s. [https://www.reuters.com/newsArticle.jhtml?type=worldNews&storyID=8903452 (Reuters)]{{Dead link|date=August 2021 |bot=InternetArchiveBot |fix-attempted=yes }}
* [[Israel]]i military tribunal convicts ex-soldier [[Wahid Taysir]] of [[manslaughter]] for killing British peace activist [[Tom Hurndall]] in April 2003. The victim's family accuses Israeli army of using Taysir as a [[scapegoat]].
